description: This class includes the general construction of all kinds of buildings and structures.
includes: construction of all types of residential buildings: single-family houses, multi-family buildings, apartment blocks
construction of commercial buildings: office buildings, stores, warehouses
construction of industrial buildings: factories, workshops
construction of public buildings: schools, hospitals, government buildings
erection of prefabricated buildings on site
renovation and repair of existing buildings
construction of specialised buildings: sports facilities, churches, theatres
excludes: construction of industrial facilities (factories excluding buildings), see 4290
subdivision of real estate into lots, see 6810
